title: Number 30 and string “30”: same appearance, different contract
goal: Validate JSON/XML schema, types and limits without executing input text.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P10. Distinguish a common-module function from its application caller; preserve your source and run a separate training infobase.

sections.title: The question we are checking
paragraphs: Both packets look plausible, but one stores minutes as a number and the other as text. A JSON parser can read both. Schema validation, rather than parsing success, decides whether they are acceptable.
Use a new training copy and invented records only. Predict first, then compare the observation; preserve existing functions, files, and records.

sections.title: Own copy, common module and separate caller
paragraphs: Continue your own training copy after P10. Preserve a DT backup and previous sources, restore into a separate new infobase and verify its path. Preserve prior work and records.

Put functions in server common module УчебныйОбмен: Server/Server call enabled, Client, Global, Privileged disabled. Данные.bsl and Приложение.bsl belong to different modules. Append only missing definitions and retain one copy of each helper.
Preserve the previous application handler first. Remove only the added startup call after one experiment. Your UUIDs and own process port may differ from the author’s observation.

sections.title: Serialization carries data
paragraphs: JSON carries values but does not automatically preserve every 1C-specific type. References need agreed external keys, dates a format/timezone, and money precision rules. A customer display name is not identity. Define required fields, types, ranges and protocol version in a schema.

The complete source accepts JSON text with exactly schemaVersion, minutes, text. Validate string type/4096 length, syntax, field set, types and integer range 0…1440. Parsing alone is not schema validation. This limit applies to materialized input; a network stream needs its own bound.

sections.title: The complete function: what happens to the data
paragraphs: УчебныйОбмен common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.
This is Данные.bsl for the common module. The separate application source below calls it. Do not paste both files into one editor.

sections.title: The application call and its observation
paragraphs: Number 30 and text containing & and angle brackets survive JSON writing and rereading. String “30” is rejected by type. The API creates own XML, then checks its request root and minutes attribute. Arbitrary external XML is not accepted.
Each message is labelled: identical Да values concern different assertions. Find the expression behind each line and distinguish its truth from the fact that the program ran.

sections.title: Parsing is not validation
paragraphs: Syntactically valid{"minutes": "30"}can violate a numeric requirement. Do not coerce every input and hide sender defects. Separate parsing, schema validation, business rules and persistence. Handle unknown versions and critical unexpected fields under an explicit policy.

A valid packet uses version 1, numeric 30 and synthetic text containing& and< >. JSON writing/reading preserves number and text. String"30" is deliberately rejected; implicit coercion would change the versioned contract.

sections.title: Your prediction first
paragraphs: Must syntactically valid minutes="30" satisfy a numeric-minutes contract?
Identify the changed action and what should remain unchanged. Reveal the explanation after making your own prediction.

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. Automatic conversion hides a sender’s contract violation. Validation explicitly requires a number, integral minutes within range and version 1. The 4096 limit concerns an already received string, not the incoming network stream.

sections.title: Bound size and structure
paragraphs: Check byte limits before expensive parsing and structure depth/count during validation. Reject DOCTYPE/ENTITY in teaching XML imports; do not enable external entities for convenience. Never pass text toExecute. Regex is not a general XML parser, so exercise formats are deliberately constrained.

Generate XML only from own data using the platform writer: request root, minutes attribute and text node. The API escapes special characters. This test checks root/attribute and is not a complete arbitrary-XML/XSD validator; it accepts no user DTD/external documents.

sections.title: Trace preservation step by step
paragraphs: Valid syntax does not rule out a wrong version, extra field or string instead of number. The new zero distinguishes type from plausible presentation. DTD, external entities and a complete XSD validator are not tested here.
Read each arrow: what value or relation exists now, and which action changes it? The diagram explains the selected property rather than replacing the source.

sections.title: An error that can look successful
paragraphs: Raw serialization text is compared and another JSON field order is treated as different data, or ПрочитатьJSON is followed by saving without field validation. Compare semantic fields; parsing grants no permission to write.
Keep the faulty copy separate. To establish a fix, compare the relevant observation with your prior expectation; do not change an expectation merely to obtain a match.

sections.title: Test round trips
paragraphs: Serialize a synthetic request, parse and compare semantic fields rather than JSON key order. Include Cyrillic, quotes, zero, missing required data, wrong types and oversized input. Rejection must not leave partially created customers/documents. Raw-payload hash and semantic identity are distinct.

Run from the server common module and print JSONВерный, ТипОтклонен, XMLВерный. In another copy test an unknown fourth field, version 2, fraction 30.5 and length 4097. Record each expected rejection; none should modify infobase documents.

sections.title: Now a new independent task
paragraphs: A new valid packet contains numeric 0 and own text with & and < >. Confirm that 0 stays numeric. Separately refuse version 2, a fourth field, fraction 0.5 and a 4097-character string. None of these cases creates documents.
The worked example addresses another question. Begin with this task’s starter and reveal the reference after your attempt. Viewing an example or reference does not replace your code.

sections.title: Where to run it and what to observe in 1C
paragraphs: УчебныйОбмен common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.

Preserve the previous handler separately. Run the experiment once in your copy, compare labelled messages and specific new records, then remove only the added startup call. Do not delete records to match a screenshot.

sections.title: Limits of the observation and your explanation
paragraphs: Only the described training paths are established. Real HTTPS services, arbitrary URLs, concurrent first delivery, crash recovery, background queues and scheduling remain NOT RUN. Technical observations, self-report and learner understanding are separate.
Separate parsing, schema, business rules, persistence and the untested arbitrary-XML import.
